cues: Hooker sucks the wound for dear life, but the ache creeps into his arms and throat, and he knows it is no good.
He sits by the pile of gold and watches his companion's body quiver.
A breeze stirs high above, and the white petals of some unknown flower come floating down through the gloom.
He does not tell us Hooker dies.
